# frozen_string_literal: true

# Which adapter answers for a firm. A namespace owes the ports a `Connection`
# model and a `Client` that includes `TokenRefreshable`, beside the services the
# ports call.
module TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Registry
  class UnknownProviderError < StandardError; end

  # Juno is absent until it moves behind the ports (roadmap stage 4/5).
  ADAPTERS = {instead: TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead}.freeze
  # The firm flag each provider is offered under. A provider with no entry is
  # offered to every firm.
  FEATURE_FLAGS = {instead: :tax_automations_instead}.freeze

  module_function

  # The adapter a named provider is served by. A firm switching vendors names the
  # new one in the request while its settings row still names the old one, so the
  # provider is the primitive and the firm is looked up through it.
  #
  # @param provider [String, Symbol, nil]
  # @return [Module] the adapter namespace
  # @raise [UnknownProviderError] when no adapter has registered under it
  def adapter_for_provider(provider)
    ADAPTERS.fetch(provider&.to_sym) do
      raise UnknownProviderError, "no tax automations adapter is registered for provider #{provider.inspect}"
    end
  end

  # The client a connection's own vendor is spoken to through.
  #
  # @param connection [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::HasOauthConnection]
  # @return [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient]
  # @raise [UnknownProviderError] when the row belongs to no registered adapter
  def client_for(connection)
    adapter = connection.class.module_parent
    adapter_for_provider(provider_of(adapter))::Client.new(connection)
  end

  # @param firm [Firm]
  # @return [Module] the adapter namespace
  # @raise [UnknownProviderError] when the firm chose no provider, or chose one
  #   no adapter has registered under
  def adapter_for(firm)
    provider = provider_for(firm)

    adapter_for_provider(provider)
  end

  # The provider a namespace is registered under — what a send record snapshots.
  #
  # @param adapter [Module]
  # @return [Symbol, nil]
  def provider_of(adapter)
    ADAPTERS.key(adapter)
  end

  # Every registered adapter, for work that names no provider: a firm that left
  # one vendor for another still holds the rows the first wrote, and a firm being
  # deleted is losing the settings row that would have named either.
  #
  # @return [Array<Module>] the adapter namespaces
  def adapters
    ADAPTERS.values
  end

  # The provider the firm chose, or nil when it chose none. Answers rather than
  # raises: an unchosen provider is where every firm starts, and the contract
  # reports it as `null`.
  #
  # @param firm [Firm]
  # @return [String, nil]
  def provider_for(firm)
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::FirmSettings.find_by(firm_id: firm.id)&.provider
  end

  # The connection the firm holds, in whatever state — what the contract reports.
  # A revoked grant is still the firm's connection.
  #
  # @param firm [Firm]
  # @return [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::HasOauthConnection, nil]
  def connection_for(firm)
    adapter_for(firm)::Connection.for_firm(firm)
  end

  # Every grant the firm holds, across vendors. Takes the id rather than the
  # record, and resolves no provider: its callers run after a firm-lifecycle
  # event, when the firm may be gone and its settings row with it.
  #
  # @param firm_id [Integer]
  # @return [Hash{Symbol => Array<TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::HasOauthConnection>}] keyed by provider
  def connections_for(firm_id)
    ADAPTERS.transform_values { |adapter| adapter::Connection.where(firm_id:).to_a }
  end

  # The connection a request goes out on, or nil when nothing is usable.
  #
  # @param firm [Firm]
  # @return [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::HasOauthConnection, nil]
  def usable_connection_for(firm)
    adapter_for(firm)::Connection.usable_for(firm)
  end

  # The capability passport. Describes the vendor, so it answers with no row.
  #
  # @param firm [Firm]
  # @return [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::HasCapabilities::Capabilities]
  def capabilities_for(firm)
    adapter_for(firm)::Connection.capabilities
  end

  # Whether a provider is offered to the firm. One rule for every provider: only
  # its flag withholds it.
  #
  # @param provider [String, Symbol, nil]
  # @param firm [Firm]
  # @return [Boolean]
  def provider_available?(provider, firm)
    feature_flag = FEATURE_FLAGS[provider&.to_sym]

    feature_flag.nil? || Platform::FeatureFlags.feature_available?(feature_flag, firm)
  end

  # Whether the firm may send through the provider it chose. A firm that chose
  # none is not withheld anything here — the export refuses it with a reason it
  # can act on.
  #
  # @param firm [Firm]
  # @return [Boolean]
  def sending_available?(firm)
    provider_available?(provider_for(firm), firm)
  end
end
